frequency_question: What proportion of threatened major trade tariffs are implemented without delay or replacement within the policy window?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly announced, specific tariff rates on major import sectors/countries by U.S. administrations. Excludes broad statutory reviews or routine anti-dumping duties.

cases.name: 2019 Proposed Tariffs on Mexico over Migration

coverage_note: 6 named cases covering major historical trade dispute escalations; believed to represent the primary set of comparable high-salience executive tariff threats.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture informal or sub-threshold negotiating threats that never reached formal proclamation stages.
validity_reason: Executive trade policy mechanisms and negotiation dynamics remain stable across multi-year presidential administration cycles.
